text.p: Deutsche Bank confirmed on Monday that, while it had not yet reached a deal on a pooling of its stake in German builder Philipp Holzmann with one owned by Hochtief, it was in talks to that end.
There has been rising speculation that Deutsche would pool its 25.8 percent stake with a 20 percent interest held by Hochtief, which after Holzmann is Germany's second largest construction group.
The aim of such a deal would be to increase Hochtief's management control over Holzmann.
The Deutsche spokesman did not specify with whom the talks were being held and when a decision could be expected.
The Sueddeutsche Zeitung newspaper reported at the weekend that a decision on the pooling together of shares could be made at a Deutsche supervisory board meeting this week.

A German court of appeals is due to start from April 9 hearings as to whether Hochtief should be allowed to extend its stake further. Cartel authorities earlier vetoed a plan under which Hochtief would up its stake to 35 percent.
Hochtief was not immediately available to comment.
